title: Considerations for Punitive Actions against Employer of Former Foreign Domestic Worker Parti Liyani for Illegal Deployment
what_it_is: Considerations for Punitive Actions against Employer of Former Foreign Domestic Worker Parti Liyani for Illegal Deployment

sections.label: Illegal deployment enforcement and penalties
sections.summary: MOM considers harm to the worker and extent of illegal deployment, and from 2017 to 2019 averaged 550 complaints and actions against 155 employers yearly.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In determining punitive actions for illegal deployment, MOM's key considerations are the degree to which the well-being of the foreign domestic worker has been compromised, and the extent of the illegal deployment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: At the conclusion of MOM's investigations in May 2018, in consultation with the Attorney-General's Chambers or AGC, the Ministry took no further action against Mr Liew.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: A Caution was issued to Mrs Liew and an Advisory Notice to Mr Karl Liew.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: From 2017 to 2019, there was an average of 550 complaints of illegal deployment of foreign domestic workers each year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Of these, MOM took actions against an average of 155 employers per year for illegally deploying their foreign domestic workers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: On average, 16 employers were issued with financial penalties each year, ranging from $3,300 to $24,000.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: There is a review on-going for this particular case regarding Ms Parti Liyani's illegal deployment arising from the High Court's observations.

sections.label: Review of punishment framework
sections.summary: The punishment framework will be reviewed and employers will be taken action against in similar illegal deployment cases regardless of awareness.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: In light of the particular vulnerability of foreign domestic workers, we will review our punishment framework and action will be taken against employers in similar illegal deployment cases, regardless of whether they are aware of the illegal deployment.
